pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: app/page.tsx:60 The streaming Suspense boundary on the landing page renders a fallback that lacks vertical height reservation for the delayed ledger entries, causing visible layout shifts once the streamed DenikSlot resolves.

techniques.evidence: app/page.tsx:60 Fallback DenikTeaserPending only renders a header and a short paragraph without reserving height for the multi-item ledger that streams in ~12 seconds later.
app/layout.tsx:108 Shell only loads Plausible pageview analytics; 75th percentile Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) are not collected and no pre-merge route byte limits are configured.
app/layout.tsx:28 Self-hosts Archivo and Plex Mono with Latin/Latin-ext character subsets for Czech typography, while pruning unused 127KB Fraunces serif to stay within font payload budget.
app/layout.tsx:110 Loads the third-party analytics script with strategy="afterInteractive" so it executes outside the critical render-blocking path.
app/layout.tsx:8 Imports global styles directly in the root layout to ensure the stylesheet link is emitted in server-rendered HTML for look-ahead scanner discovery.
app/page.tsx:48 Landing page loader trims the 200+ MP leaderboard down to 5 featured entries on the server, avoiding transferring and parsing a 120KB payload on the client.
